caption: The drawing is done in black and white pencil on a pale tan background. The central object is a large, footed mug with a pronounced bulbous lower body, a gently flaring rim, and an ornate, curving handle decorated with spiral details. The mug sits on a slightly raised circular base. In the upper left corner of the drawing, enclosed in a square, is a detailed monogram surrounded by a wreath-like border, with the letter "M" at the center. In the upper right corner, also within a square, is a side profile view of the mug, which highlights the outline of the handle and the mug’s contours. The lines of the drawing are precise, with areas of shading used to suggest the three-dimensional form and reflective surface of the mug. The composition consists of three distinct framed sections within the rectangular paper, centering attention on the mug and providing additional detail in the corners.
title: Silver Mug
